review:
Eager Beavers is a 6-reel slot with random reel heights and up to 1,000,000 ways. Wild features fill the base game, and in the Cash Bonus Game you build, upgrade and collect.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 10,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.29%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
